# Tut-P

> Parent-centered EdTech platform for Indian families — scores parental
> engagement, not just child performance, across homework help, quizzes,
> storytelling, experiential learning, and play-based learning.

Tut-P (https://tutp.online) helps Indian parents actively participate in
their children's education through AI-assisted homework help, multiplayer
learning games, and a Parent Engagement Score that tracks involvement
rather than just grades.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://tutp.online/): product overview, pricing tiers, and FAQ.
- [Live Demo](https://tutp.online/demo/): a working demo of the parent/child homework flow.
